title: AutoDiDact: Input Reduction over Inferred Structure
abstract: arXiv:2611.20969v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Delta debugging reduces a failing input by deleting chunks of it, keeping a deletion only if an oracle confirms the failure persists. It chunks the input based only on its length, so its deletions cut through units such as identifiers and delimited groups, wasting calls and leaving outputs large. Current state-of-the-art structural reducers avoid this by supplying grammars or built-in format knowledge. We show that structured reduction needs neither: a neutral word and delimiter pairs suffice, and both can be inferred from the failing input by asking only what delta debugging already asks its oracle: does the failure persist?   A neutral word, such as a space, preserves the failure when inserted between such units but not inside them, so it splits the input into tokens. translated_title: AutoDiDact：基于推断结构的输入约简
translated_abstract: Delta debugging（增量调试）通过删除失败输入中的片段来约简输入，只有当预言机确认失败仍然存在时才保留删除。它仅根据输入的长度来分块，因此其删除操作会切断诸如标识符和定界组之类的单元，浪费调用次数并使输出仍然较大。当前最先进的结构化约简器通过提供文法或内置的格式知识来避免这一问题。我们证明结构化约简两者皆不需要：一个中性词和定界符对就足够了，而且两者都可以从失败输入中推断出来，只需询问 delta debugging 本来就会问其预言机的问题：失败是否仍然存在？中性词（例如空格）插入在这些单元之间时不会破坏失败，但插入在单元内部时则会，因此它可以将输入切分成标记。定界符对是两个只有在同时添加或删除时才保持失败不变的标记，因此它们所界定的范围可以作为一个单元来约简。我们对两者进行了形式化定义，并陈述……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AutoDiDact方法，证明结构化输入约简无需文法或内置格式知识，仅通过反复询问预言机“失败是否仍然存在”即可从失败输入中自动推断出中性词与定界符对，从而在标识符、定界组等结构单元层面高效约简输入。
en_tdlr: AutoDiDact shows that structured input reduction needs neither grammars nor built-in format knowledge: neutral words and delimiter pairs can be inferred from the failing input simply by asking the delta debugging oracle whether the failure persists, enabling reduction at the level of units such as identifiers and delimited groups.
